title: Agent Tracing Observability: Langfuse vs AgentOps vs LangSmith
excerpt: A practical comparison of Langfuse, AgentOps, and LangSmith for debugging multi-agent systems, with the setup code and trade-offs that actually matter.
seo_title: Agent Tracing Observability for CrewAI & LangGraph
meta_description: Learn how to add agent tracing observability to CrewAI and LangGraph using Langfuse, AgentOps, or LangSmith, with real setup code and honest trade-offs.
social_message:
I lost 3 hours debugging a CrewAI agent that wasn't actually stuck.

Turns out it was silently retrying a slow tool call. Here's how Langfuse, AgentOps, and LangSmith trace that in minutes, with real setup code for CrewAI and LangGraph.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/agent-tracing-observability/
📌 On Instagram? Link in bio.
